properties.name: developer.apps.sync-interval-ms
properties.description: How often, in milliseconds, the service retries pushing app changes to the wallet service until it confirms them.

properties.name: developer.mail.startup-check.enabled
properties.description: Check the mail settings after the service has started and log the result: whether mail is on, whether the mail server accepts the login, and, when send-test-to is set, send one test email. It never stops the service from starting.

properties.name: developer.mail.startup-check.send-test-to
properties.description: Email address that receives one test email at every start while the startup check is enabled. Leave empty to send none.

properties.name: spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.auth
properties.description: Log in to the mail server with the username and password. Gmail needs this on.

properties.name: spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.connectiontimeout
properties.description: Milliseconds to wait when connecting to the mail server before giving up. Jakarta Mail waits forever when this is not set.

properties.name: spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.starttls.enable
properties.description: Upgrade the connection to TLS with STARTTLS before logging in. Gmail on port 587 needs this on.

properties.name: spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.starttls.required
properties.description: Refuse to send when the mail server does not offer STARTTLS, so the login is never sent in clear text.

properties.name: spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.timeout
properties.description: Milliseconds to wait for the mail server to answer once connected before giving up. Jakarta Mail waits forever when this is not set.

properties.name: spring.mail.properties.mail.smtp.writetimeout
properties.description: Milliseconds to wait while sending data to the mail server before giving up. Jakarta Mail waits forever when this is not set.

properties.name: developer.seed-admins.enabled
properties.description: Create the first two administrators when the service starts. Does nothing once an administrator exists, or when either email address is already used. Set to false to switch it off. It never stops the service from starting.

properties.name: developer.seed-admins.first.email
properties.description: Email address of the first administrator to create at startup.

properties.name: developer.seed-admins.first.first-name
properties.description: First name of the first administrator.

properties.name: developer.seed-admins.first.last-name
properties.description: Last name of the first administrator.

properties.name: developer.seed-admins.first.password
properties.description: Password of the first administrator. It must meet the password rules. It is hashed before it is stored and never logged. Remove it from the .env file once the account exists.

properties.name: developer.seed-admins.second.email
properties.description: Email address of the second administrator to create at startup.

properties.name: developer.seed-admins.second.first-name
properties.description: First name of the second administrator.

properties.name: developer.seed-admins.second.last-name
properties.description: Last name of the second administrator.

properties.name: developer.seed-admins.second.password
properties.description: Password of the second administrator. It must meet the password rules. It is hashed before it is stored and never logged. Remove it from the .env file once the account exists.
